determinism_floor.note: assistant<->helpful_assistant verbatim-duplicate raw-L20 distance - a batching/execution-determinism floor, NOT a centroid-SE estimate (question-sampling error cancels between verbatim twins). Non-blocking; the centroid-SE read is the split_half diagnostic.

split_half.definition: 1 - cos(half1_centroid, half2_centroid), raw L20, per persona

synthetics.selection_on_noise_caveat: Kept synthetics are selected on ONE measured landing, so their true distances regress slightly toward the source; with the measured determinism floor <=0.005 against 0.05-wide bands the bias is small, but a ~0.201 landing should not be narrated as solidly very-far.
